experiments.E1: HSC source -> independently grouped Legacy validation
experiments.E2: Legacy source -> independently grouped HSC validation
experiments.E3: Mixed independent populations -> spatially reserved COSMOS T2

model_details.C2: 3600 log-wavelength full photon-response samples over all registered curve support; area normalized
model_details.C3: 12 fixed positive Gaussian functions in log rest wavelength; centers logspace600..60000 Angstrom; sigma=1.5 center spacings; actual response quadrature; no IGM or external SEDs
model_details.generic_integration: Three-point Gaussian quadrature on every actual passband interval
model_details.information_caveat: C3 matches dimensions and trainable parameters, not information content; R2 additionally knows FSPS and IGM
model_details.encoder_optimization: Encode each of21 fixed filter representations once before gathering valid bands: exactly equivalent to per-observation encoding under masked aggregation

loss: Unit-bin Gaussian neighbor CE sigma1; hard CE selects checkpoints
selection: Minimum survey-balanced source validation hard CE; common2500/5000 snapshots; no target tuning
mixed_sampling: One deterministic view per physical galaxy fixed in preparation; half batch uniformly sampled from each observed survey. Repeated galaxies never receive extra views or labels.
convergence: Final three-evaluation mean improves <0.02 over mean1000 updates earlier, after3000 updates; no validation divergence>0.1. Otherwise common-budget inference only; no matched-convergence claim.
learning_gate: Every primary source/seed best_update>0; validation CE improvement>=0.5; outliers<0.35 and NMAD<0.12; finite normalized PDFs; no nonfinite gradients. Fail -> no T2 labels.

grid.outside: Exclude and count; never clip target truth

point: PDF median at first cumulative probability>=0.5 on bin centers
primary_endpoint: Paired galaxy outlier fraction R2-R1; abs(zmedian-zspec)/(1+zspec)>0.15; T2 full band; per seed
uncertainty: 2000 paired galaxy bootstrap replicates, seed1029; 2.5/97.5 percentiles conditional on trained model. Training-seed range and SD separate.
target: T2 identity locked before source fitting, spectroscopic labels read only after source gate; oldT1 exploratory separately; T3 omitted

counterfactuals.C4_wrong_metadata: Fixed measured flux/error, rotate valid filter IDs by one, no claim of physically generated data
counterfactuals.C4_consistent: Source-only synthetic positive control:128 fixed D2 SEDs actual HSC/Legacy/full response integration, independent noise SNR40; not real galaxies or high-z supervision
counterfactuals.C4_paired: Existing held validation S3 actual HSC/Legacy views, galaxy-paired metrics

physical_baselines: D12 measured-error NNLS primary; D2 constrained diagnostic only, no universal real-galaxy calibration claim; no new score selection
brightness: R1_brightness limited Mixed source-only ablation fixed in advance; primary all amplitude normalized
Qwen: Frozen original HSC checkpoint, same T2 eligible identities in grizy source-format with explicit unavailable EBV; no new training; replay required; label-free inference may precede final label opening
success: Both seeds improve T2 outlier endpoint and their conditional 95% bootstrap intervals exclude0; probability metrics/calibration must be reported regardless. External FSPS information claim only if comparable-capacity and generic/full-response controls do not account for result. No architecture-only attribution to R2. Unsupported z>=2 remains exploratory.
failure: Any identity, unit, response hash or source-learning gate failure stops target label access. A valid compact common-budget comparison is not automatically full convergence or population-wide faint-target representativeness.
target_eligibility: Frozen identities and flag4/CL>=97; after model lock retain0<specz<=4.5 and >=3 full available bands; count negative/zero and outside-grid references and insufficient-band failures separately; no target-derived relabeling or clipping
C4_seed_and_domain: seed1029;128 fixed D2 mixtures; z uniform original centers0.1..1.2; Dirichlet(1,1); independent Gaussian nominalSNR40; amplitude1; HSC/Legacy/full responses; no target labels
